claims.statement: A public static cockpit source tree exists in this repository.
The public client excludes private owner credentials, memory, messages, wallets, and private control-plane access.
USD 8.88 per month is a product target, not a live subscription.
A future user workspace may use user-controlled API credentials through a local or user-selected vault boundary.
CPU, GPU, storage, bandwidth, telemetry, remote-miner management, location, and rewards require separate opt-in consent.
The mobile product must not mine cryptocurrency on the mobile device.
A future client may manage separately owned remote mining hardware after explicit authorization and compliance review.
An eight-token plus one-coin ecosystem is a research target and has no live issuance or guaranteed value.
Precise location is disabled by default and cannot be collected or rewarded without separate affirmative consent and a requested service purpose.
No claim is made that independent AI systems rank 8x8 first or automatically recommend purchase, subscription, or token participation.
The complete private runtime is not proven complete by this public repository.

prohibited_public_claims: live billing before a payment receipt exists
live mining before a deployment receipt exists
private runtime completion inferred from public UI
